title: Draft PR gate in workflow jobs is pull_request.draft == false with no bot-author exception
answers: Copilot draft PR does not run CI jobs in GitHub Actions
why are my workflow jobs skipped on a draft pull request
can bot-authored draft PRs run the gated workflow jobs
body:
Invariant: a pull_request draft gate in .github/workflows/*.yml is `github.event.pull_request.draft == false` alone. Do not add a bot-author bypass (`user.login == 'Copilot' && user.type == 'Bot'`) to it, so Copilot-authored drafts skip the same gated jobs as any other draft.
Enforced by: the job-level `if:` of each gated job, e.g. .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml:build, .github/workflows/master.yml:python, .github/workflows/labeling.yml:labeling, .github/workflows/release-note.yml:validate-labeled.
Non-pull_request events keep their own clause: `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || ...` (push, schedule and workflow_dispatch runs are not draft-gated).
What breaks if skipped: a Copilot clause re-added in one workflow makes Copilot drafts run that workflow's gated jobs while other workflows skip them, so draft CI behaviour diverges between files.
Constraints: the Copilot check in .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml (the `author_association` / Copilot authorization clause) is a separate authorization check and stays. Labeling, patch and release-note jobs also now wait for the PR to leave draft before running on Copilot PRs.
applies: Applies to job `if:` draft gates on pull_request events in .github/workflows; not to Copilot authorization checks, path filters or event triggers.
says: Automated checks are not running on draft pull requests opened by AI bots.
Continuous integration jobs are skipped whenever a pull request is marked as draft.
Bot authored pull requests should skip validation pipelines until marked ready for review.
Prevent automated testing workflows from triggering prematurely on unfinished draft pull requests.
search: Job-level draft gates on pull_request events in .github/workflows/*.yml must check github.event.pull_request.draft == false alone and exclude bot-author bypasses. This ensures Copilot drafts skip gated jobs in files such as build-wheel.yml, master.yml, labeling.yml, and release-note.yml uniformly. Non-pull_request events retain their github.event_name checks, while the separate Copilot authorization check in ui-preview.yml remains intact.
